description: Verify that TCP sends an ACK in response to a FIN received in FIN-WAIT-1 or FIN-WAIT-2 (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
When DUT has already sent its own FIN (FW1 / FW2) and the peer also FINs, DUT must ACK the peer's FIN. From FW1 the joint state is CLOSING; from FW2 it's TIME-WAIT.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Phase 1: DUT in FW1 → tester FIN → DUT must emit ACK.
2. Phase 2: DUT in FW2 → tester FIN → DUT must emit ACK.

[Pass condition]
DUT emits ACK to the tester FIN in both phases (preceded by DUT's own FIN).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_p1_fin / Fail_timeout_p1_ack — phase 1 DUT FIN or ACK missing
• Fail_timeout_p2_fin / Fail_timeout_p2_ack — phase 2 DUT FIN or ACK missing

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked tester FIN in FW1 and FW2 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_p1_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 1
verdicts.Fail_timeout_p2_ack: No DUT ACK to tester FIN phase 2
